items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Now there is a Riddick here that's a heart specialist, Dr. Frank Riddick. There are several Riddicks here. A.G. Riddick, Archie Riddick. But now, Dr. Frank Riddick, and we are definitely a distant blood relative.

ctx.x: Now there is a Riddick here that's a heart specialist, Dr. Frank Riddick. There are several Riddicks here. A.G. Riddick, Archie Riddick. But now, Dr. Frank Riddick, and we are definitely a distant blood relative. Because we all came from the same neck of the woods, Virginia.
Oh, I see. Yeah. Well, are you related to the Riddicks with the R-E-D? No. It's a different family.
Now, all of that, you wouldn't believe it, but we're Scotch.
